title: feat: encoded preview decodes ahead

commit.merge_subject: merge: feat: encoded preview decodes ahead

description: EncodedSource(readAhead = true), used by the preview session only: a helper thread owns the reader and decoder, decodes the requested frame (frames before it without a pixel copy) and then the next one or two into a queue (depth 1 for 8K-class frames, heap limit 256 MB), so a sequential playback overlaps decode with the GPU develop. Adapter copies the interleaved chroma once into one pooled array (U and V are views of it) and the YUV JNI door uses GetPrimitiveArrayCritical. PlaneBufferPool is synchronized. Device numbers (debug, tier 720, 14 s): Mi-Log 4K60 shown 116-206, gap p50 63-95 ms, p95 144-199 ms; 8K30 shown 175, p50 74, p95 124 ms; run-to-run spread is large and smooth playback is not reached yet (see STATUS update 6). JVM 2950/0.
changed: feat: encoded preview decodes ahead on a helper thread
